subject: ACME - Updated pricing & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (pricing)

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

- Expected monthly token volume: 50M - 150M (you said baseline ~100M, spikes to ~130M).
- Workload mix: chat generation ~75-80%, embeddings ~15-20%, reranking/other ~5%.
- Key priorities: predictable unit economics, committed-capacity pricing, and an SLA for latency on chat endpoints.
- Target budget you mentioned: roughly $20k–$40k / month. You asked for a per-1M-token target around $300 — we'll use that as a starting point for modeling.

I attached a cost model and a draft invoice estimate (ACME_pricing_calc_20260915.xlsx; ACME_invoice_estimate_20260915.pdf). The spreadsheet has two scenarios:
  1) Pay-as-you-go (no commit)
  2) 6mo reserved capacity with tiered discounts (we show a 20% effective discount at your target commit level).

Immediate asks so we can finalize numbers:
- Confirm expected steady-state monthly tokens (firm number if possible, e.g., 100M).
- Breakdown by endpoint (chat vs embeddings) — the cost per token differs by model/runtime.
- If procurement needs a formal estimate, copy their email and we'll generate a one-page invoice-ready PDF.

Next steps: I can finalize the invoice estimate and share a DocuSign when you confirm the monthly volume and procurement contact.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

Attachments: ACME_pricing_calc_20260915.xlsx (spreadsheet), ACME_invoice_estimate_20260915.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Jane Lee <jane.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:11:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (pricing)

Thanks Sean — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We expect steady-state ~120M tokens / month (this includes live app traffic + batch jobs). Peak months might go to ~150M but planning should use 120M.
- Endpoint split: chat (text-gen) ~80% (96M), embeddings ~15% (18M), reranking/other ~5% (6M).
- Procurement/finance are targeting a budget ceiling of $30k / month, but there is flexibility if the committed pricing yields better unit economics.
- Our internal target for cost efficiency is ≈ $250–$300 per 1M tokens (that's what product/finance said they'd be comfortable approving).

Procurement contact: procurement@acme.com (you can send an official invoice estimate for review). Also, can you confirm: 
- Do the reserved-capacity discounts apply to all token types or only chat endpoints?
- Is there a minimum commit term to realize the 20% discount in your spreadsheet?

Looking forward to the estimate.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of AI Product, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 14:02, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call:...

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jane Lee <jane.lee@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: ACME - pricing model & invoice estimate (attached)

Alex / procurement team — attaching the finalized estimate and a simplified cost breakdown per your asks. Highlights below and slides attached.

Summary (based on 120M monthly tokens, workload split you provided):
- Steady-state tokens: 120,000,000 / month (baseline scenario)
- Workload: chat 80% (96M), embeddings 15% (18M), other 5% (6M)
- Unit economics (model + infra blended cost): 
  - Base cost to Redwood (inference + infra amortized): ~$160 per 1M tokens
  - Recommended list price: $320 per 1M tokens (standard markup + support/ops)
  - 6-month reserved capacity pricing (20% off list): $256 per 1M tokens

Estimate (monthly):
- List price scenario (no commit): 120 * $320 = $38,400 / month
- Reserved 6mo (20% off): 120 * $256 = $30,720 / month
- Effective $/1M tokens with reserved discount: ~$256 (meets your $250–$300 target range)

Line items in attached token_cost_breakdown.csv show per-endpoint runtime assumptions and model choices used in the calc (e.g., chat = model-redwood-xl-8k, embeddings = embed-redwood-v2). The attached spreadsheet (ACME_pricing_calc_20260915.xlsx) includes a sensitivity table for volumes from 80M–160M and the corresponding monthly invoice.

Answers to your questions: 
- Reserved-capacity discounts apply across the board to the units covered by the commit (chat + embeddings included), unless you carve out a specific pool (we can model that).
- Minimum commit term for the 20% shown is 6 months with a monthly minimum of 100M tokens equivalent. We can model a 3-month pilot with a smaller discount.

Requested next steps: 
1) Procurement: confirm the billing contact and whether a PO or DocuSign is required.
2) If the 6mo commit looks good, we can generate a formal SOW + invoice for signature (I'll attach DocuSign links once you confirm).
3) Scheduling: propose a 30-min pricing review with finance next week to walk the spreadsheet (I'll send calendar options).

If it helps, I can produce a one-page invoice-ready PDF broken out by line item and service codes for your AP team — let me know and I'll send it to procurement.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

Attachments: ACME_pricing_calc_20260915.xlsx, ACME_invoice_estimate_20260915.pdf, token_cost_breakdown.csv
